entities.name: Disability Rights Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A broad social movement advocating civil rights, equal opportunity, and anti-discrimination legislation for people with disabilities. Emerged in the 1960s, it secured landmark legislation including the ADA (1990), the UK Disability Discrimination Act (1995), and the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (2006).
